articles.title: Microsoft 365 outage drags on, but things are improving - TechCrunch
articles.description: Microsoft 365 and Outlook are still seeing service degradations on Tuesday, the company's status page indicates.
articles.content:
Microsoft’s efforts to fix what is now a multi-day outage affecting customers’ access to Outlook email and other Microsoft 365 services are entering day two.
